about: Made by .github/desktop/ai/make_focal_shift_golden.py, whose header describes the fit. points are x, y, z one after the other, row after row; uv the same in pairs; the mask one value per point.

cases.name: exact
cases.description: a wall leaning back, exact points: the shift and the focal length of the camera come back

cases.name: noisy
cases.description: the same wall with noise on every coordinate

cases.name: masked
cases.description: a room with its top third without depth: only the valid points count

cases.name: exif
cases.description: a portrait frame with the EXIF of a 28 mm lens: the shift for the focal of the EXIF

cases.name: exifMismatch
cases.description: a 4:3 frame whose EXIF says 50 mm while the points say a wide lens: fovGuessed
